source_document: Legal Constitution, Lawyer Review Version L1.10 — docs/02-legal-domain/LEGAL_CONSTITUTION_L1.10.md
source_quote: The Partner is responsible for primary/first-line customer service and technical support to End Customers it brings in, particularly where reselling and billing directly. The Company provides support to the Partner's own technical team, and may at its discretion provide direct support to End Customers for complex issues. The Partner is expected to maintain trained personnel for first-level inquiries and escalate per agreed procedures.

evaluation_rules._note: presence is established by the mapping layer alone (45D)

_calibration: THE TWO-TIER PATTERN IS THE BASELINE, AND THE ABSENCE OF L1/L2/L3 IS NOT A DEVIATION. §31.6a is explicit: the three-tier structure is 'NOT CURRENTLY ADOPTED', and 'Legal Mind must NOT flag the absence of an L1/L2/L3 structure as a deviation in any document'. No standard is ratified for §31.6a, and none may be — its basis would be NOT_ADOPTED, which is never a current rule.
Appendix B has NO clause category for partner support responsibilities, so `constitution.topic` takes §31.6's own heading. That is a routing label, not a legal position.

This standard checks that the support split is ADDRESSED, not that it is worded identically — §31.6 describes a responsibility allocation, and the evaluator is PRESENCE precisely because there is no number to compare.
